test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct sequence to form a meaningful sentence:

(A) the cat (B) sleeping (C) is (D) under the table
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3)** i.e. **ACBD**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "**the cat**," which is correctly indicated by **part (A).**
 
• Following the subject, "**is**" (C) connects the subject with the action, making the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• The next part "**sleeping**" (B) describes the action of the cat.
 
• Ending with "**under the table**" (D) provides the location, completing the sentence meaningfully.

Therefore, the correct answer is **ACBD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1 (ABDC):** This option starts with "the cat sleeping under the table is," which disrupts the logical flow and creates a grammatically incorrect sentence.
 
• **Option 2 (ADBC):** This option starts with "the cat under the table sleeping is," which creates a fragmented and confusing sentence structure.
 
• **Option 4 (ADCB):** This option starts with "the cat under the table is sleeping," which incorrectly places the location before the verb.
